cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: MUFASA is an offline scientific-reasoning model for African learners, researchers and technical practitioners. The model is adapted on African research literature and supervised scientific conversations, then deployed as a compact GGUF model for local CPU inference on affordable hardware.

test_prompts.prompt: A smallholder maize field in northern Nigeria receives 42 mm of rainfall in one week. Estimated crop evapotranspiration is 31 mm, surface runoff is 6 mm, and deep percolation is 3 mm. Assuming negligible irrigation, calculate the weekly change in soil-water storage in millimetres and cubic metres per hectare. Show the reasoning and state one agronomic implication if the same balance persists for four weeks.

A Sahelian monitoring site shows a sharp decline in NDVI over six weeks. Rainfall is below the long-term mean, daytime land-surface temperature has increased, and there is no evidence of recent harvesting. Explain how these observations support or weaken a drought interpretation, identify one alternative explanation that should still be checked, and name two additional measurements that would reduce uncertainty.
